overview: Host John Petrella interviewed lifelong Medford resident Greg Carbonello about his personal journey through active opioid addiction, his path to recovery, and the local support systems available to those struggling with substance abuse.

items.title: Introduction and Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Greg Carbonello, who shared his background growing up in Medford and his long career in the criminal justice field.

items.title: Journey with Addiction
items.summary: Carbonello recounted how his path to addiction began with underage gambling and escalated into a 20-year dependency on prescription opioids following a 2003 car accident.

items.title: Road to Recovery
items.summary: Carbonello described his transition to active recovery in July 2023, utilizing an employee assistance program to enter treatment in Portland, Maine, followed by a sober house in Malden.

items.title: Support Systems and Advice
items.summary: Carbonello and Petrella discussed navigating family dynamics, the stigma around addiction, and various local recovery meetings and municipal support services in Medford and Malden.

items.title: Future of Recovery Support
items.summary: Carbonello advocated for youth prevention education and expanded community outreach to combat the fentanyl epidemic before Petrella concluded the episode.
